name: Static Loss
summary:
Static Loss is a first-person VR horror experience designed to put players in a tense and unsettling atmosphere. Explore dark, abandoned hallways and large rooms. As you move in deeper, you will get lost, but finding secrets on the way is the best part. The game focuses on exploration, suspense, and psychological tension to create a truly horrifying horror experience. If you enjoy being scared and exploring unknown places, Static Loss will keep you questioning what’s real—and what’s watching you.
